request.description: Create a pending deployment attempt. The backend validates the token, organization, deployer wallet, chain and eligibility. Only open MetaMask when the response is successful, status is 'pending', and canInitiateTransaction is true. Idempotent by idempotencyKey; a live pending attempt for the same token+wallet is returned instead of duplicated (HTTP 200), a new one is HTTP 201.

Resume-after-refresh. Reports the token status and the latest/active attempt so the frontend can decide whether to create a new attempt, continue waiting for confirmation, finalize, or show the token as already deployed. Captures deploymentAttemptUid when present.

Record the broadcast transaction hash immediately after MetaMask broadcasts. This does NOT mark the token deployed - a hash only proves broadcast, not success. Idempotent for the same hash; a different hash returns HTTP 409 TRANSACTION_HASH_CONFLICT.

item.name: Deploy 4 - Optional - Fail / Reject Deployment Attempt

request.description: Close a pending attempt when the user rejects MetaMask or transaction preparation fails before broadcast. Allowed statuses: wallet_rejected, cancelled, failed. Idempotent. An attempt that already has a broadcast transaction hash cannot be closed here (HTTP 409) - it must be verified instead.

Finalize deployment. The backend independently verifies the on-chain transaction (never trusts the frontend). Send deploymentAttemptUid + transactionHash for the two-phase flow; sending only transactionHash remains supported for backward compatibility. Returns 200 when finalized (token deployed), or 202 while the transaction is still confirming.
Issuer-only. Updates the owning deployed token currentTokenPrice without changing initialTokenPrice. New transaction intents snapshot this value.

exec: pm.test('Current token price is updated', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

For a token, returns each required claim topic with satisfied/missing/rejected flags and the investor's matching documents, plus eligible, missingClaimTopics, interestStatus, and a rejection block (rejectReasonType, rejectReason, rejectedClaim, rejectedCount, canResubmitClaim, resubmitRemaining, canResubmit) when the interest was rejected.

Always creates/refreshes an interest. Missing required claim documents -> status 'pending' (issuer cannot see it); all documents present -> status 'submitIntrest' (issuer sees it). Requires a submitted investor and a deployed token.
The investor's own interests with token summary (including maxInvestors and maxBalancePerInvestor). Optional query: ?status=pending|submitIntrest|approved|rejected|cancelled.

item.name: Upload Claim Document (for pending / rejected interest)

request.description: Reuses the investor document upload. For a SUBMITTED investor this is allowed only when a 'pending' or resubmittable DOC_REJECTED interest exists (else 403). After upload the backend promotes pending interests to submitIntrest and resolves re-uploaded rejected claims. Select a PDF/PNG/JPG file for 'documents'.
Interests for the issuer's organization. Issuers see only 'submitIntrest' by default. Use ?status=claimSubmitted to find subscriptions eligible for Add to Registry, or ?status=all.
A single interest (asserts org ownership) with all documents the investor submitted (each with claimTopicCode + downloadUrl) and the required claim-topic eligibility breakdown.

Requires a claimSubmitted or already synchronized registered interest. For a new on-chain registration, creates PENDING before MetaMask. If matching on-chain registry state already exists, no PENDING row or MetaMask call is created: the backend finds and verifies the authoritative IdentityRegistered transaction, inserts CONFIRMED directly, and returns 200. A temporary 503 must be retried without opening MetaMask. Use only the returned registry/wallet/identity/country values for registerIdentity().

exec: pm.test('Registry operation created, resumed, or synchronized', () => pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Resume state after refresh. The backend returns its current PENDING/CONFIRMED record.

Send only the MetaMask hash. Backend supports a direct registerIdentity transaction or a strictly decoded single execution through a configured MetaMask Delegation Manager. It verifies chain, issuer sender, zero native value, direct/nested registry target and calldata, canonical receipt, IdentityRegistered event, and final state. A successful confirmation atomically sets the interest to registered and records registered history. 202 means wait/poll; only 200 with status CONFIRMED is complete.
Approves a 'submitIntrest' interest (-> approved). 409 if it is not submitIntrest.

Rejects due to documents. rejectedClaims must be claim-topic codes required by the token (stored comma-separated in rejectedClaim). The investor can then re-upload those claim documents while resubmission attempts remain.
Rejects for a non-document reason. No claim-topic selection is required.
Downloads one of the investor's submitted documents (ownership + path-safety checked).

item.description: Token marketplace (admin+investor), investor submit-interest journey (pending/submitIntrest by claim-topic eligibility), and issuer review (approve / reject with DOC_REJECTED resubmission). Set investorToken via a User Login as the investor, userToken via a User Login as the issuer, and adminToken via Admin Login.

item.name: Investor Claim Submission (Hybrid)
item.description: Fast and idempotent investor claim flow. Prepare creates the one logical DB row. Submit stores/verifies the wallet hash. Retry verifies the known hash or performs one Identity.getClaim read; it never waits for a historical log scan. Open MetaMask again only when Retry returns TRANSACTION_REQUIRED. SYNCING means the global indexer/targeted recovery worker is reconciling the actual event hash.

request.description: Lists trusted issuer-signed claim parameters and current states. Captures the first claimId for the following requests.
Creates/resets the single PENDING row and returns trusted ONCHAINID call arguments. Call this before MetaMask.
Set investorClaimTxHash to the real MetaMask transaction hash. The backend persists it before receipt verification.

exec: pm.test('Claim is confirmed or awaiting confirmations', () => pm.expect([200, 202]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Fast recovery. CONFIRMED=no action; PENDING_CONFIRMATION=wait; SYNCING=poll; TRANSACTION_REQUIRED=frontend may open MetaMask.

exec: pm.test('Retry status drives the wallet UI', () => pm.expect(json.data.status).to.be.oneOf(['CONFIRMED', 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', 'SYNCING', 'TRANSACTION_REQUIRED']));
